name: Sweet & Sour Coconut Popcorn Chicken with Ginger-Garlic Green Beans

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg green beans
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ oranges

instructions.primary_message: Trim and discard ends of the green beans; transfer to one of the baking sheets, in a single layer.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; sprinkle both over the green beans. Set aside.
Place coconut and almond flour in a large bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups shredded unsweetened coconut
¾ cup almond meal/flour

instructions.primary_message: Whisk the eggs in a second large bowl.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Toss chicken in the egg to coat. Working in batches, transfer chicken to the coconut mixture and turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Place chicken on the other the baking sheet, in a single layer.
Drizzle oil over the beans and chicken. Place both baking sheets in the oven and bake until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, and beans are fork-tender, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice oranges into a medium saucepan. Add ketchup, oil, soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; whisk to combine. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp ketchup
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
Add cornstarch slurry to the saucepan in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Cook, whisking often, until sweet and sour sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Drizzle sweet and sour sauce over the baked chicken and gently toss to coat.
To serve, divide chicken and beans between plates. Sprinkle chicken with sesame seeds and enjoy!
